Format all code using the linter formatter:
make build_staging
make test_staging
make test_staging ONLY_TESTING=PocketCastsTests/YourTestClass/testMethodName
make test_staging ONLY_TESTING=PocketCastsDataModelTests
make test_staging ONLY_TESTING=PocketCastsServerTests
make test_staging ONLY_TESTING=PocketCastsUtilsTests

Data operations must use `DataManager.sharedManager` (Modules/DataModel/Sources/PocketCastsDataModel/Public/DataManager.swift). Modules are under `Modules/`; app source is `podcasts/`.

Strings: add to `podcasts/en.lproj/Localizable.strings`, always include translator/context comments, use snake_case `feature_relevantIdentifier_description`, positional specifiers (`%1$@`, `%2$@`), never string interpolation, and manually separate `_singular`/`_plural` keys. Use generated `L10n`.

Use `naturalContentHorizontalAlignment` instead of `.left`/`.right`; use `.natural` text alignment instead of `.left`. Never use `LocalizedStringKey` in SwiftUI - use `NSLocalizedString` with L10n. Use `<REDACTED_USER> private var theme: Theme`, inject `.environmentObject(Theme.sharedTheme)`, and use `AppTheme.color(for: .primaryText01, theme: theme)`.

brew install protobuf swift-protobuf  # One-time setup
make update_proto API_PATH=/path/to/pocketcasts-api/api/modules/protobuf/src/main/proto
